styles.cardart: Premium hand-painted card illustration for a fantasy mobile strategy card game, Supercell Clash Royale card-art quality. Polished stylized 3D-painted look, chunky cute-but-heroic proportions with a slightly oversized head, saturated colors, crisp readable silhouette. Royal blue (#2f6bff) and gold are the team accent colors.
styles.frame_unit: Vertical portrait composition: the subject is big and close to the camera, shown from roughly the knees up, filling most of the frame, in a dynamic mid-action pose with energy and motion, head in the upper third. Behind it a softly blurred painterly fantasy battlefield background with depth, dramatic warm key light and a bright rim light separating the subject from the background, subtle glow and particles. Full-bleed image: no border, no card frame, no text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no watermark.
styles.frame_spell: Vertical portrait composition: the magical effect is big and centered, filling most of the frame, bursting with energy, light and particles over a softly blurred painterly fantasy battlefield background with depth and dramatic lighting. Full-bleed image: no border, no card frame, no text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no watermark.

items.name: knight
items.subject: A sturdy young knight in shining silver plate armor with gold trim, a royal blue plume on his helmet and a flowing royal blue cape, raising a broadsword for a heroic strike while bracing a kite shield with a gold lion emblem, determined grin.

items.name: archers
items.subject: Two young elven archer girls with royal blue hooded cloaks and pink braided hair, side by side, the front one drawing a wooden longbow with an arrow nocked and aiming past the camera, the second one behind her pulling an arrow from her quiver, confident smirks.

items.name: imps
items.subject: A gang of three small mischievous green-skinned goblin imps with huge pointy ears and sharp toothy grins, tiny royal blue bandanas and leather rags, sprinting and leaping toward the camera brandishing crude curved daggers, the front imp biggest and closest.

items.name: brute
items.subject: A huge hulking stone golem brute made of grey boulders with moss on its shoulders, glowing warm amber eyes, a royal blue sash with a gold buckle, rearing back to smash a massive rocky fist down, pebbles and dust flying.

items.name: ironclad
items.subject: A compact, intimidating warrior in full dark gunmetal steel plate armor with a closed helmet and a glowing icy-white visor slit, royal blue tabard, hefting an enormous two-handed broadsword over his shoulder ready to swing, sparks and cold blue glow.

items.name: gunner
items.subject: A stout bearded dwarf gunner in an iron helmet with brass goggles and a royal blue long coat with gold buttons, firing a big brass blunderbuss with a bright muzzle flash and smoke, grinning with one eye squinted.

items.name: wyrmling
items.subject: A cute chubby baby dragon with royal blue scales, a cream belly, small gold horns and big friendly eyes, swooping toward the camera with wings spread wide, breathing a gout of bright orange fire, embers swirling.

items.name: boneswarm
items.subject: A rowdy horde of small goofy cartoon skeleton warriors with ivory bones and tattered royal blue scarves, charging toward the camera waving short rusty swords and small round wooden shields, one big goofy skeleton in front with many more behind, bones rattling.

items.name: boarrider
items.subject: A wild barbarian with a tall mohawk and royal blue war paint riding a charging armored brown war boar with big tusks straight toward the camera, swinging a big war hammer over his head, dust clouds kicked up behind.

items.name: pyromancer
items.subject: A dramatic old fire wizard with a tall pointed royal blue hat, flowing royal blue robes with gold trim and a long white beard blowing in the wind, conjuring a huge blazing fireball in his raised hand that lights his face orange.

items.name: berserker
items.subject: A fierce red-haired viking shieldmaiden berserker with braids, in a royal blue fur-trimmed tunic, mid-spin swinging a huge double-bladed battle axe in a wide motion-blurred arc, shouting a battle cry.

items.name: gargoyles
items.subject: Three small winged grey stone gargoyles with bat-like wings, little curved horns, glowing blue eyes and royal blue loincloths, diving through the sky toward the camera with claws out and mischievous grins, the front one biggest.

items.name: blimp
items.subject: A round hot-air balloon bomber with a royal blue and gold striped balloon drifting over a battlefield, a wooden basket hanging below loaded with big round black bombs with lit sparking fuses, a tiny goblin pilot with goggles cackling and dropping a bomb.

items.name: lancer
items.subject: A heroic armored knight lancer in a plumed helmet galloping on a rearing white warhorse with a royal blue and gold caparison, thrusting a long jousting lance forward toward the camera, dust and speed lines.

items.name: turret
items.subject: A sturdy wooden and iron defensive ballista crossbow turret on a round stone base with small royal blue pennant flags, just firing a giant iron-tipped bolt toward the camera with the string snapping forward, wood splinters and a burst of air.

items.name: imphut
items.subject: A crooked little goblin hut made of wooden planks with a straw roof and patched cloth and a royal blue flag on top, warm light glowing from its round doorway as a grinning green goblin imp bursts out of the door waving a dagger.

items.name: fireorb
items.subject: A massive blazing fireball of swirling orange and yellow flames with a long fiery trail, plunging diagonally down from the sky toward a battlefield, sparks and embers flying.

items.name: arrows
items.subject: A dense volley of wooden arrows with royal blue fletching raining diagonally down from a bright sky, motion streaks, some arrows close to the camera and huge.

items.name: spark
items.subject: A crackling bright cyan-white lightning bolt striking down from a dark storm cloud, branching electric arcs and a bright impact flash at the bottom.

items.name: wardrums
items.subject: A big wooden war drum with royal blue and gold bands being struck by two drumsticks, shockwaves of glowing magenta-purple rage energy pulsing outward from the drum skin.

items.name: frost
items.subject: An exploding nova of glowing pale blue ice: a giant sharp ice crystal snowflake bursting outward with frost shards, swirling snow and cold sparkles.

items.name: mending
items.subject: A glowing golden healing potion bottle tipping over and pouring a radiant beam of warm green-gold healing light, floating hearts and sparkles rising in a soft holy glow.
